status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Split-flap
summary: Departure-board precision with a mechanical editorial character.
use_when: Use for status summaries, scheduled learning, and progress milestones.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: System monospace with uppercase short labels; sentence-case body.
layout: Segmented labels, crisp alignment, and clear numeric hierarchy.
surfaces: Dark mechanical panels, fine separators, optional short label flip.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Split-flap to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System monospace with uppercase short labels; sentence-case body. Segmented labels, crisp alignment, and clear numeric hierarchy. Dark mechanical panels, fine separators, optional short label flip. Palette: background #121514, surface #202522, text #f4f5e9, muted #c0c5b7, accent #ebd8a8, border #687263. Essential traits: Segmented mechanical headings; Matte board surfaces; Legible state labels. Avoid: Continuous flipping; All-caps paragraphs; Animations that hide current values. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
